philosophers.name: Thales
philosophers.summary: First philosopher in Western tradition. Proposed water as the fundamental substance (arche) of all things.
philosophers.summary_zh: 西方哲学传统的开创者。提出水是万物的本原（arche）。

philosophers.name: Anaximander
philosophers.summary: Proposed the apeiron (the boundless) as the origin of all things. Made early contributions to cosmology.
philosophers.summary_zh: 提出“无限者”（apeiron）为万物本原，对早期宇宙论有重要贡献。

philosophers.name: Pythagoras
philosophers.summary: Founded a philosophical-religious school centered on mathematics and harmony as the basis of reality.
philosophers.summary_zh: 创立以数学与和谐为实在基础的哲学宗教学派。

philosophers.name: Heraclitus
philosophers.summary: Philosopher of flux and change. Everything flows (panta rhei); fire as the fundamental element; unity of opposites.
philosophers.summary_zh: 变化哲学家。万物皆流（panta rhei），以火为本原，对立统一。

philosophers.name: Parmenides
philosophers.summary: Argued that change is an illusion and reality is one, eternal, and unchanging. Founded Eleatic school.
philosophers.summary_zh: 认为变化是幻觉，实在是唯一、永恒、不变的。创立爱利亚学派。

philosophers.name: Empedocles
philosophers.summary: Proposed four classical elements (earth, water, air, fire) driven by Love and Strife.
philosophers.summary_zh: 提出四元素说（土、水、气、火），以爱与争为驱动力。

philosophers.name: Anaxagoras
philosophers.summary: Introduced Nous (Mind) as the organizing principle of the cosmos. Teacher of Pericles.
philosophers.summary_zh: 引入“努斯”（Nous，心智）作为宇宙的组织原理。伯里克利的老师。

philosophers.name: Protagoras
philosophers.summary: Leading Sophist. 'Man is the measure of all things.' Pioneer of relativism.
philosophers.summary_zh: 智者派代表。“人是万物的尺度”。相对主义先驱。

philosophers.name: Socrates
philosophers.summary: Founder of Western moral philosophy. Developed the Socratic method of dialectical questioning. Wrote nothing.
philosophers.summary_zh: 西方道德哲学奠基者。创立苏格拉底问答法。本人未留下任何著作。

philosophers.name: Democritus
philosophers.summary: Co-founder of atomism. All things are composed of indivisible atoms moving in void.
philosophers.summary_zh: 原子论创始人之一。万物由不可分的原子在虚空中运动组成。

philosophers.name: Plato
philosophers.summary: Theory of Forms: true reality consists of eternal, perfect Ideas. Founded the Academy. Shaped all subsequent Western philosophy.
philosophers.summary_zh: 理念论：真实由永恒完美的理念构成。创立学园。塑造了整个西方哲学传统。

philosophers.name: Aristotle
philosophers.summary: Systematized logic, ethics, metaphysics, politics, and natural philosophy. Founded the Lyceum. The philosopher of common sense and empirical observation.
philosophers.summary_zh: 系统化了逻辑学、伦理学、形而上学、政治学和自然哲学。创立吕克昂学园。

philosophers.name: Diogenes
philosophers.summary: The archetypal Cynic. Lived in a barrel, rejected social conventions, sought virtue through radical simplicity.
philosophers.summary_zh: 典型的犬儒学派哲学家。住在桶里，拒绝社会习俗，追求极简的德行。

philosophers.name: Epicurus
philosophers.summary: Founded Epicureanism. Pleasure (ataraxia, tranquility) as the highest good. Atomic materialism.
philosophers.summary_zh: 创立伊壁鸠鲁学派。以快乐（宁静/ataraxia）为至善。原子唐物主义。

philosophers.name: Zeno of Citium
philosophers.summary: Founded Stoicism. Virtue as the sole good; live according to nature and reason; endure with equanimity.
philosophers.summary_zh: 创立斯多葛学派。德行为唯一的善；顺应自然与理性而活。

philosophers.name: Cicero
key_works: On the Nature of the Gods
philosophers.summary: Roman statesman and philosopher. Transmitted Greek philosophy to the Latin world. Natural law theory.
philosophers.summary_zh: 罗马政治家与哲学家。将希腊哲学传播到拉丁世界。自然法理论。

philosophers.name: Seneca
philosophers.summary: Roman Stoic. Adviser to Nero. Influential moral essays and letters on practical philosophy.
philosophers.summary_zh: 罗马斯多葛哲学家。尼禄的顾问。以实践哲学的道德随笔和书信闻名。

philosophers.name: Epictetus
philosophers.summary: Born a slave, became one of the most influential Stoic teachers. Focus on what is in our control.
philosophers.summary_zh: 生为奴隶，成为最具影响力的斯多葛学派教师。专注于我们能控制的事情。

philosophers.name: Marcus Aurelius
philosophers.summary: Roman Emperor and Stoic philosopher. His Meditations is a timeless work of personal ethics.
philosophers.summary_zh: 罗马皇帝与斯多葛哲学家。《沉思录》是个人伦理学的不朽之作。

philosophers.name: Plotinus
philosophers.summary: Founder of Neoplatonism. The One emanates reality through successive levels: Nous, Soul, Matter.
philosophers.summary_zh: 新柏拉图主义创始人。“太一”通过流溢产生实在：努斯、灵魂、物质。

philosophers.name: Augustine of Hippo
key_works: On Free Choice of the Will
philosophers.summary: Synthesized Christian theology with Neoplatonic philosophy. Original sin, divine grace, free will, just war theory.
philosophers.summary_zh: 将基督教神学与新柏拉图主义融合。原罪、神恩、自由意志、正义战争理论。

philosophers.name: Boethius
philosophers.summary: Last of the Romans, first of the Scholastics. Translated Aristotle into Latin. Wrote on fate, free will, and divine providence.
philosophers.summary_zh: “最后的罗马人，经院哲学的先驱”。将亚里士多德译为拉丁文。

philosophers.name: Anselm of Canterbury
philosophers.summary: Father of Scholasticism. The ontological argument: God is that than which nothing greater can be conceived.
philosophers.summary_zh: 经院哲学之父。本体论证明：上帝是无法设想更伟大之物。

philosophers.name: Peter Abelard
philosophers.summary: Pioneer of scholastic method (Sic et Non). Conceptualist position on universals. Ethics of intention.
philosophers.summary_zh: 经院方法的先驱（《是与否》）。共相问题上的概念论立场。意图伦理学。

philosophers.name: Thomas Aquinas
philosophers.summary: Greatest Scholastic philosopher. Synthesized Aristotelian philosophy with Christian theology. Five Ways to prove God's existence. Natural law ethics.
philosophers.summary_zh: 最伟大的经院哲学家。将亚里士多德哲学与基督教神学融合。五路证明。自然法伦理学。

philosophers.name: Duns Scotus
philosophers.summary: The Subtle Doctor. Haecceity (thisness) as principle of individuation. Univocity of being.
philosophers.summary_zh: “精微博士”。以“此性”（haecceitas）为个体化原理。存在的单义性。

philosophers.name: William of Ockham
philosophers.summary: Ockham's Razor: entities should not be multiplied beyond necessity. Radical nominalism. Separation of faith and reason.
philosophers.summary_zh: 奥卡姆剃刀：如无必要，勿增实体。激进的唯名论。信仰与理性的分离。

philosophers.name: Al-Kindi
philosophers.summary: Father of Islamic philosophy. First to systematically introduce Greek philosophy into the Arab-Islamic world.
philosophers.summary_zh: 伊斯兰哲学之父。第一个系统地将希腊哲学引入阿拉伯-伊斯兰世界。

philosophers.name: Al-Farabi
philosophers.summary: The Second Teacher (after Aristotle). Political philosophy, logic, and metaphysics. The ideal state ruled by a philosopher-prophet.
philosophers.summary_zh: “第二导师”（仅次于亚里士多德）。政治哲学、逻辑学与形而上学。

philosophers.name: Avicenna (Ibn Sina)
philosophers.summary: Greatest Islamic philosopher. Essence-existence distinction. The Flying Man thought experiment. Synthesized Aristotelian and Neoplatonic thought.
philosophers.summary_zh: 最伟大的伊斯兰哲学家。本质与存在的区分。“飞人”思想实验。融合了亚里士多德与新柏拉图思想。

philosophers.name: Al-Ghazali
philosophers.summary: Critiqued philosophers' claims to certainty. Argued causality is not necessary but habitual (anticipating Hume). Turned to Sufism.
philosophers.summary_zh: 批判哲学家对确定性的宣称。认为因果关系是习惯而非必然（预见了休谟）。转向苏菲主义。

philosophers.name: Averroes (Ibn Rushd)
philosophers.summary: The Commentator. Defended philosophy against Al-Ghazali. Double truth theory. Massive influence on Latin Scholasticism.
philosophers.summary_zh: “注释家”。针对安萨里为哲学辩护。双重真理论。对拉丁经院哲学有巨大影响。

philosophers.name: Ibn Khaldun
philosophers.summary: Pioneer of historiography and sociology. Cyclical theory of civilizations. Asabiyyah (social cohesion) as the engine of history.
philosophers.summary_zh: 史学与社会学的先驱。文明循环理论。“阿萨比亚”（社会凝聚力）为历史动力。

philosophers.name: Laozi
philosophers.summary: Legendary founder of Daoism. The Dao (Way) that can be told is not the eternal Dao. Wu wei (non-action). Return to naturalness.
philosophers.summary_zh: 道家创始人。道可道，非常道。无为而无不为。复归自然。

philosophers.name: Confucius
philosophers.summary: Founder of Confucianism. Ren (benevolence), Li (ritual propriety), Junzi (the exemplary person). Reshaped East Asian civilization.
philosophers.summary_zh: 儒学创始人。仁、礼、君子。重塑了东亚文明。

philosophers.name: Mozi
philosophers.summary: Founded Mohism. Universal love (jian'ai) against Confucian partial love. Consequentialism. Anti-war. Logic and science.
philosophers.summary_zh: 墨家创始人。兼爱、非攻、尚贤。功利主义。重视逻辑与科学。

philosophers.name: Zhuangzi
philosophers.summary: Master of Daoist philosophy and literature. The butterfly dream. Relativity of perspectives. Freedom through wu wei.
philosophers.summary_zh: 道家哲学与文学大师。庄周梦蝶。视角的相对性。以无为获自由。

philosophers.name: Mencius
philosophers.summary: Human nature is innately good. Four sprouts of virtue. Benevolent government. Right of revolution against tyrants.
philosophers.summary_zh: 性善论。四端说。仁政。民贵君轻，革命权。

philosophers.name: Xunzi
philosophers.summary: Human nature is bad; goodness comes through education and ritual. Emphasis on learning and social order.
philosophers.summary_zh: 性恶论，善由教化与礼义而来。强调学习与社会秩序。

philosophers.name: Han Fei
philosophers.summary: Synthesizer of Legalist thought. Rule by law, authority, and technique. Realpolitik. Influenced Qin dynasty governance.
philosophers.summary_zh: 法家思想集大成者。法、术、势。现实政治。影响秦朝治理。

philosophers.name: Dong Zhongshu
key_works: Luxuriant Dew of the Spring and Autumn Annals
philosophers.summary: Established Confucianism as state ideology under Emperor Wu of Han. Heaven-human resonance theory. Yin-yang cosmology.
philosophers.summary_zh: 将儒学确立为汉武帝时期的国家意识形态。天人感应。阴阳宇宙论。

philosophers.name: Wang Bi
key_works: Commentary on the Dao De Jing
philosophers.summary: Died at 23 but revolutionized Chinese metaphysics. Concept of 'wu' (nothingness) as the root of being. Founded Xuanxue (Dark Learning).
philosophers.summary_zh: 23岁英年早逝却革新了中国形而上学。以“无”为万有之本。创立玄学。

philosophers.name: Zhu Xi
key_works: Collected Commentaries on the Four Books
philosophers.summary: Greatest Neo-Confucian. Li (principle) and Qi (material force). Investigation of things. Defined the orthodoxy for 700 years.
philosophers.summary_zh: 最伟大的理学家。理与气。格物致知。定义了此后700年的正统。

philosophers.name: Wang Yangming
philosophers.summary: Unity of knowledge and action. Innate moral knowledge (liangzhi). Challenged Zhu Xi's dualism with a more experiential approach.
philosophers.summary_zh: 知行合一。致良知。以更重体验的方式挑战朱熙的二元论。

philosophers.name: Siddhartha Gautama (Buddha)
philosophers.summary: Founded Buddhism. Four Noble Truths. Eightfold Path. Anatta (no-self). Middle Way between asceticism and indulgence.
philosophers.summary_zh: 佛教创始人。四圣谛。八正道。无我。中道。

philosophers.name: Mahavira
philosophers.summary: 24th Tirthankara and key figure in Jainism. Ahimsa (non-violence). Anekantavada (many-sidedness of reality).
philosophers.summary_zh: 耆那教第24代祖师。不害（ahimsa）。多元实在论（anekantavada）。

philosophers.name: Nagarjuna
philosophers.summary: Founder of Madhyamaka (Middle Way) school. Sunyata (emptiness): all phenomena lack inherent existence. Tetralemma logic.
philosophers.summary_zh: 中观学派创始人。空性（sunyata）：一切现象缺乏自性。四句论证。

philosophers.name: Vasubandhu
philosophers.summary: Co-founder of Yogacara (consciousness-only) school. Reality is constructed by mind. Pioneered Buddhist logic.
philosophers.summary_zh: 唯识学派创始人之一。万法唯识。开创了佛教因明学。

philosophers.name: Adi Shankara
philosophers.summary: Founder of Advaita (non-dual) Vedanta. Brahman alone is real; the world is maya (illusion); Atman is Brahman.
philosophers.summary_zh: 不二论吔檀多创始人。梵独为实在；世界为幻（maya）；我即梵。

philosophers.name: Ramanuja
philosophers.summary: Qualified non-dualism (Vishishtadvaita). Individual souls are real but part of Brahman. Devotion (bhakti) as path to liberation.
philosophers.summary_zh: 有限定的不二论。个体灵魂真实但为梵的一部分。以虔诚（bhakti）为解脱之路。

philosophers.name: Machiavelli
philosophers.summary: Father of modern political science. Politics as it is, not as it ought to be. Virtu and fortuna.
philosophers.summary_zh: 现代政治学之父。政治实然而非应然。德性与命运。

philosophers.name: Francis Bacon
philosophers.summary: Father of empiricism and the scientific method. Knowledge is power. Idols of the mind. Inductive reasoning.
philosophers.summary_zh: 经验主义与科学方法之父。知识就是力量。心智的偶像。归纳推理。

philosophers.name: Thomas Hobbes
philosophers.summary: State of nature is war of all against all. Social contract creates the sovereign. Materialist metaphysics.
philosophers.summary_zh: 自然状态是一切人对一切人的战争。社会契约创造主权者。唐物主义形而上学。

philosophers.name: Descartes
philosophers.summary: Father of modern philosophy. Cogito ergo sum. Mind-body dualism. Method of systematic doubt. Clear and distinct ideas.
philosophers.summary_zh: 现代哲学之父。我思故我在。身心二元论。系统怀疑法。清晰明白的观念。

philosophers.name: Spinoza
philosophers.summary: God or Nature (Deus sive Natura). Monist substance metaphysics. Geometric method in philosophy. Freedom through understanding necessity.
philosophers.summary_zh: 神即自然。一元实体形而上学。几何学方法做哲学。通过理解必然性获得自由。

philosophers.name: John Locke
philosophers.summary: Tabula rasa: mind begins as a blank slate. Natural rights (life, liberty, property). Government by consent. Foundation of liberalism.
philosophers.summary_zh: 白板说。自然权利（生命、自由、财产）。政府基于同意。自由主义基石。

philosophers.name: Leibniz
philosophers.summary: Monads: reality consists of simple, mind-like substances. Best of all possible worlds. Pre-established harmony. Co-inventor of calculus.
philosophers.summary_zh: 单子论：实在由简单的心灵实体构成。最佳可能世界。前定和谐。微积分共同发明者。

philosophers.name: George Berkeley
key_works: A Treatise Concerning the Principles of Human Knowledge
philosophers.summary: Esse est percipi (to be is to be perceived). Immaterialism: only minds and ideas exist. Critique of abstract ideas.
philosophers.summary_zh: 存在就是被感知。非物质主义：只有心智与观念存在。抽象观念的批判。

philosophers.name: Montesquieu
philosophers.summary: Separation of powers (legislative, executive, judicial). Climate theory of government. Influenced American and French constitutions.
philosophers.summary_zh: 三权分立（立法、行政、司法）。政体的气候理论。影响美法宪法。

philosophers.name: David Hume
philosophers.summary: Problem of induction. Is-ought gap. Bundle theory of self. Causation as habit. Woke Kant from his dogmatic slumber.
philosophers.summary_zh: 归纳问题。是-应该问题。自我的束簇论。因果为习惯。唤醒了康德的教条迷梦。

philosophers.name: Jean-Jacques Rousseau
philosophers.summary: Man is born free but everywhere in chains. General will. Noble savage. Natural education. Forerunner of Romanticism.
philosophers.summary_zh: 人生而自由，却无往不在枚锁之中。公意。高贵的野蛮人。自然教育。浪漫主义先驱。

philosophers.name: Immanuel Kant
philosophers.summary: Copernican revolution in philosophy. Synthetic a priori knowledge. Categorical imperative. Transcendental idealism. The towering figure of modern philosophy.
philosophers.summary_zh: 哲学中的哥白尼革命。先天综合知识。绝对命令。先验唯心论。现代哲学的巨人。

philosophers.name: G.W.F. Hegel
philosophers.summary: Dialectical method (thesis-antithesis-synthesis). Absolute Idealism. History as the self-realization of Spirit (Geist). Master-slave dialectic.
philosophers.summary_zh: 辩证法（正-反-合）。绝对唯心论。历史是精神（Geist）的自我实现。主奴辩证法。

philosophers.name: Arthur Schopenhauer
key_works: The World as Will and Representation
philosophers.summary: The world is driven by blind, purposeless Will. Life is suffering. Aesthetic contemplation and compassion as temporary escapes. Influenced by Buddhism.
philosophers.summary_zh: 世界由盲目无目的的意志驱动。人生即苦。审美与同情为短暂的解脱。受佛教影响。

philosophers.name: Kierkegaard
philosophers.summary: Father of existentialism. Leap of faith. Three stages of existence (aesthetic, ethical, religious). Critique of Hegel's system. Anxiety and despair.
philosophers.summary_zh: 存在主义之父。信仰的飞跃。存在的三阶段（审美、伦理、宗教）。批判黑格尔体系。

philosophers.name: Karl Marx
philosophers.summary: Historical materialism. Class struggle as the engine of history. Alienation. Critique of capitalism. Base and superstructure.
philosophers.summary_zh: 历史唐物主义。阶级斗争为历史动力。异化。资本主义批判。基础与上层建筑。

philosophers.name: John Stuart Mill
philosophers.summary: Higher and lower pleasures. Harm principle. Champion of individual liberty and women's rights. Refined utilitarianism.
philosophers.summary_zh: 高级与低级快乐。伤害原则。个人自由与女性权利的捍卫者。精化了功利主义。

philosophers.name: Friedrich Nietzsche
philosophers.summary: God is dead. Will to power. Eternal recurrence. Ubermensch. Master and slave morality. Revaluation of all values.
philosophers.summary_zh: 上帝已死。权力意志。永恒轮回。超人。主人与奴隶道德。重估一切价值。

philosophers.name: Charles Sanders Peirce
key_works: How to Make Our Ideas Clear
philosophers.summary: Founder of pragmatism. Meaning of a concept lies in its practical consequences. Semiotics. Fallibilism. Abductive reasoning.
philosophers.summary_zh: 实用主义创始人。概念的意义在于其实践效果。符号学。可谬论。溢因推理。

philosophers.name: William James
philosophers.summary: Truth is what works. Radical empiricism. Stream of consciousness. Will to believe. Pluralistic universe.
philosophers.summary_zh: 真理是有用的东西。彻底的经验主义。意识流。信仰的意志。多元宇宙。

philosophers.name: Edmund Husserl
philosophers.summary: Founder of phenomenology. Back to the things themselves. Intentionality. Epoche (bracketing). Transcendental ego.
philosophers.summary_zh: 现象学创始人。回到事物本身。意向性。悬搁（epoche）。先验自我。

philosophers.name: John Dewey
philosophers.summary: Learning by doing. Democracy as a way of life. Inquiry as self-correcting process. Instrumental logic.
philosophers.summary_zh: 做中学。民主为生活方式。探究为自我纠正的过程。工具逻辑。

philosophers.name: Bertrand Russell
philosophers.summary: Co-founder of analytic philosophy. Logical atomism. Theory of descriptions. Russell's paradox. Mathematics reducible to logic.
philosophers.summary_zh: 分析哲学创始人之一。逻辑原子主义。摸述论。罗素悖论。数学可归约为逻辑。

philosophers.name: Ludwig Wittgenstein
philosophers.summary: Two philosophies: early (picture theory of language, limits of the sayable) and late (language games, family resemblance, private language argument).
philosophers.summary_zh: 两期哲学：早期（语言图像论，可说之边界）与后期（语言游戏、家族相似、私人语言论证）。

philosophers.name: Martin Heidegger
philosophers.summary: The question of Being (Sein). Dasein (being-there). Being-toward-death. Thrownness. The turn (Kehre). Technology as enframing.
philosophers.summary_zh: 存在问题。此在（Dasein）。向死而在。被抛性。转向（Kehre）。技术为座架。

philosophers.name: Jean-Paul Sartre
philosophers.summary: Existence precedes essence. Radical freedom and responsibility. Bad faith. The Look. Nothingness at the heart of consciousness.
philosophers.summary_zh: 存在先于本质。极端的自由与责任。自欺。凝视。意识核心的虚无。

philosophers.name: Simone de Beauvoir
philosophers.summary: One is not born, but rather becomes, a woman. Existentialist feminism. Ethics of ambiguity. Situated freedom.
philosophers.summary_zh: 一个人不是生为女人，而是成为女人。存在主义女性主义。模糊性伦理学。境遇自由。

philosophers.name: Hannah Arendt
philosophers.summary: Banality of evil. Vita activa: labor, work, action. Public realm as space of freedom. Natality. Thinking and judging.
philosophers.summary_zh: 平庸的恶。积极生活：劳动、工作、行动。公共领域为自由空间。出生性。思考与判断。

philosophers.name: Willard Van Orman Quine
philosophers.summary: Critique of the analytic-synthetic distinction. Indeterminacy of translation. Web of belief. Naturalized epistemology.
philosophers.summary_zh: 批判分析-综合区分。翻译不确定性。信念之网。自然化认识论。

philosophers.name: John Rawls
philosophers.summary: Justice as fairness. Veil of ignorance. Original position. Two principles of justice. Revived political philosophy in the 20th century.
philosophers.summary_zh: 公平即正义。无知之幕。原初状态。正义两原则。复兴了20世纪政治哲学。

philosophers.name: Thomas Kuhn
philosophers.summary: Paradigm shifts. Normal science vs. revolutionary science. Incommensurability of paradigms. Science is not purely cumulative.
philosophers.summary_zh: 范式转换。常规科学与革命科学。范式的不可通约性。科学并非纯籹累积的。

philosophers.name: Michel Foucault
philosophers.summary: Power/knowledge. Discourse analysis. Biopolitics. Genealogy. The panopticon. Archaeology of knowledge. Care of the self.
philosophers.summary_zh: 权力/知识。话语分析。生命政治。谱系学。全景监狱。知识考古学。自我关怀。

philosophers.name: Jacques Derrida
philosophers.summary: Deconstruction. Differance. There is nothing outside the text. Logocentrism. Supplement. Trace. Hospitality.
philosophers.summary_zh: 解构。延异（differance）。文本之外无它物。逻各斯中心主义。补充。踪迹。好客。

philosophers.name: Jurgen Habermas
key_works: The Structural Transformation of the Public Sphere
philosophers.summary: Communicative rationality. Discourse ethics. Public sphere. Ideal speech situation. Lifeworld vs. system.
philosophers.summary_zh: 交往理性。商谈伦理学。公共领域。理想言说情境。生活世界与系统。

philosophers.name: Gilles Deleuze
philosophers.summary: Philosophy of difference. Rhizome vs. arborescent thought. Deterritorialization. Immanence. Bodies without organs.
philosophers.summary_zh: 差异哲学。根茉与树状思维。解域化。内在性。无器官的身体。

philosophers.name: Robert Nozick
philosophers.summary: Minimal state. Entitlement theory of justice. Critique of redistributive taxation. Experience machine thought experiment.
philosophers.summary_zh: 最小国家。权利正义论。批判再分配税收。体验机思想实验。

philosophers.name: Richard Rorty
key_works: Philosophy and the Mirror of Nature
philosophers.summary: Anti-foundationalism. Philosophy as conversation, not mirror of nature. Liberal ironist. Bridged analytic and continental traditions.
philosophers.summary_zh: 反基础主义。哲学为对话而非自然之镜。自由反讽主义者。桥接分析与大陆传统。

philosophers.name: Saul Kripke
philosophers.summary: Rigid designators. Causal theory of reference. Possible worlds semantics. A posteriori necessities. Wittgenstein on rules.
philosophers.summary_zh: 严格指示词。因果指称理论。可能世界语义学。后验必然性。规则遵循问题。

philosophers.name: Peter Singer
philosophers.summary: Effective altruism. Animal rights based on sentience. Expanding the moral circle. Preference utilitarianism.
philosophers.summary_zh: 有效利他主义。基于感知力的动物权利。扩展道德关怀圈。偏好功利主义。
